#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exactly four serial RuntimeBench executions per runtime, ordered ABBA.

The benchmark itself is unchanged and computes seven-round medians. Aggregate
medians/ranges below describe its two process medians for each source/runtime.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SETUP = json.loads((ROOT / 'setup.json').read_text())
REPO = Path(SETUP['repo'])
RUNS = []
RESULT = {
    'setup': SETUP,
    'protocol': {
        'order_per_runtime': ['baseline', 'fixed', 'fixed', 'baseline'],
        'runtime_order': ['84', '85'],
        'iterations': 30000,
        'build_iterations': 1000,
        'internal_rounds_per_case': 7,
        'warmup_per_case': 'min(2000, case iterations)',
        'processes_per_runtime': 4,
        'opcache_cli': True,
        'timing': 'Unmodified RuntimeBench seven-round median; aggregate is median/range of two process medians per source/runtime.',
        'source_verification': 'Override all Componenta DI classmap entries and root autoload_files, precheck Container/functions reflections, postcheck every loaded DI declaration.',
        'wrapper_sha256': hashlib.sha256((ROOT / 'autoload-snapshot.php').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    },
    'runs': RUNS,
}

def save():
    (ROOT / 'runtime-abba-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(RESULT, indent=2) + '\n')

def diagnostics(stderr):
    result = {}
    for line in stderr.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('ABBA_PRECHECK '):
            result['precheck'] = json.loads(line.removeprefix('ABBA_PRECHECK '))
        elif line.startswith('ABBA_POSTCHECK '):
            result['postcheck'] = json.loads(line.removeprefix('ABBA_POSTCHECK '))
    return result

save()
for runtime in ('84', '85'):
    binary = ROOT.parent / 'runtime' / ('php' + runtime) / 'php'
    for ordinal, source in enumerate(('baseline', 'fixed', 'fixed', 'baseline'), 1):
        snapshot = Path(SETUP['snapshots'][source]['root'])
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.update({
            'DI_ABBA_REPOSITORY': str(REPO),
            'DI_ABBA_SNAPSHOT': str(snapshot),
            'COMPONENTA_DI_BENCH_AUTOLOAD': str(ROOT / 'autoload-snapshot.php'),
            'COMPONENTA_DI_BENCH_SOURCE': str(snapshot / 'src'),
            'DI_BENCH_ITERATIONS': '30000',
            'DI_BUILD_ITERATIONS': '1000',
        })
        command = [str(binary), '-d', 'opcache.enable_cli=1', str(snapshot / 'benchmarks/RuntimeBench.php')]
        print(f'START php{runtime} {ordinal}/4 {source}', flush=True)
        started = time.time()
        completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=REPO, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
        name = f'php{runtime}-{ordinal}-{source}'
        (ROOT / (name + '.stdout.txt')).write_text(completed.stdout)
        (ROOT / (name + '.stderr.txt')).write_text(completed.stderr)
        parsed = {case: float(ns) for case, ns in re.findall(r'^([a-z/-]+)\s+([0-9.]+) ns\s+[0-9]+$', completed.stdout, re.MULTILINE)}
        diag = diagnostics(completed.stderr)
        entry = {
            'php': runtime, 'ordinal': ordinal, 'source': source,
            'command': command,
            'environment': {key: env[key] for key in ('DI_ABBA_REPOSITORY', 'DI_ABBA_SNAPSHOT', 'COMPONENTA_DI_BENCH_AUTOLOAD', 'COMPONENTA_DI_BENCH_SOURCE', 'DI_BENCH_ITERATIONS', 'DI_BUILD_ITERATIONS')},
            'exit_code': completed.returncode,
            'elapsed_seconds': time.time() - started,
            'case_medians_ns': parsed, 'diagnostics': diag,
            'stdout': completed.stdout, 'stderr': completed.stderr,
        }
        RUNS.append(entry)
        save()
        if completed.returncode != 0 or len(parsed) != 6 or not diag.get('postcheck', {}).get('all_loaded_di_declarations_in_snapshot'):
            print(completed.stdout, completed.stderr, flush=True)
            raise SystemExit('Benchmark/source validation failed; no extra runs were attempted.')
        print(f'DONE php{runtime} {ordinal}/4 {source}: ' + json.dumps(parsed), flush=True)

summary = {}
for runtime in ('84', '85'):
    runtime_runs = [run for run in RUNS if run['php'] == runtime]
    cases = {}
    for case in runtime_runs[0]['case_medians_ns']:
        values = {source: [run['case_medians_ns'][case] for run in runtime_runs if run['source'] == source] for source in ('baseline', 'fixed')}
        baseline = statistics.median(values['baseline'])
        fixed = statistics.median(values['fixed'])
        cases[case] = {
            source: {'process_medians_ns': samples, 'median_ns': statistics.median(samples), 'min_ns': min(samples), 'max_ns': max(samples)}
            for source, samples in values.items()
        }
        cases[case]['fixed_vs_baseline_percent'] = (fixed / baseline - 1) * 100
        cases[case]['adjacent_pair_deltas_percent'] = [
            (runtime_runs[1]['case_medians_ns'][case] / runtime_runs[0]['case_medians_ns'][case] - 1) * 100,
            (runtime_runs[2]['case_medians_ns'][case] / runtime_runs[3]['case_medians_ns'][case] - 1) * 100,
        ]
    summary[runtime] = cases
RESULT['summary'] = summary
save()
print('COMPLETE ' + str(ROOT / 'runtime-abba-results.json'), flush=True)
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), flush=True)

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Composer\Autoload\ClassLoader;

$repository = realpath((string) getenv('DI_ABBA_REPOSITORY'));
$snapshot = realpath((string) getenv('DI_ABBA_SNAPSHOT'));
if ($repository === false || $snapshot === false) {
    throw new RuntimeException('DI_ABBA_REPOSITORY and DI_ABBA_SNAPSHOT must identify existing directories.');
}
$vendor = $repository . '/vendor';

// Composer eagerly includes the root package's functions file. Suppress only
// those entries and include the selected snapshot equivalents after remapping.
$snapshotFiles = [];
foreach (require $vendor . '/composer/autoload_files.php' as $identifier => $file) {
    if (str_starts_with($file, $repository . '/src/')) {
        $snapshotFile = $snapshot . substr($file, strlen($repository));
        if (!is_file($snapshotFile)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Snapshot autoload file is missing: ' . $snapshotFile);
        }
        $GLOBALS['__composer_autoload_files'][$identifier] = true;
        $snapshotFiles[] = $snapshotFile;
    }
}

$snapshotLoader = require $vendor . '/autoload.php';
if (!$snapshotLoader instanceof ClassLoader) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Expected the existing Composer loader.');
}

$remapped = [];
foreach ($snapshotLoader->getClassMap() as $class => $file) {
    if (!str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\')) {
        continue;
    }
    $file = realpath($file);
    if ($file === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Optimized DI classmap references a missing file: ' . $class);
    }
    if (!str_starts_with($file, $repository . '/')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Unexpected DI classmap source: ' . $file);
    }
    $snapshotFile = $snapshot . substr($file, strlen($repository));
    if (!is_file($snapshotFile)) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Snapshot classmap source is missing: ' . $snapshotFile);
    }
    $remapped[$class] = $snapshotFile;
}
if ($remapped === []) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Expected optimized Componenta DI classmap entries.');
}
$snapshotLoader->addClassMap($remapped);
$snapshotLoader->setPsr4('Componenta\\DI\\', $snapshot . '/src/');
$snapshotLoader->setPsr4('Componenta\\DI\\Tests\\Support\\', $snapshot . '/tests/Support/');
foreach ($remapped as $class => $expectedFile) {
    if ($snapshotLoader->findFile($class) !== $expectedFile) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Classmap override failed for ' . $class);
    }
}
foreach ($snapshotFiles as $file) {
    require $file;
}

$containerFile = new ReflectionClass(Componenta\DI\Container::class)->getFileName();
$functionsFile = new ReflectionFunction('Componenta\\DI\\Internal\\is_closure_reflector')->getFileName();
if ($containerFile !== $snapshot . '/src/Container.php'
    || $functionsFile !== $snapshot . '/src/Internal/functions.php'
) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Reflection source verification failed.');
}
$opcacheStatus = opcache_get_status(false);
if (!is_array($opcacheStatus) || !$opcacheStatus['opcache_enabled']) {
    throw new RuntimeException('CLI OPcache must be active for this comparison.');
}
fwrite(STDERR, 'ABBA_PRECHECK ' . json_encode([
    'php' => PHP_VERSION,
    'snapshot' => $snapshot,
    'container_file' => $containerFile,
    'functions_file' => $functionsFile,
    'remapped_classmap_entries' => count($remapped),
    'snapshot_autoload_files' => $snapshotFiles,
    'opcache_enabled' => $opcacheStatus['opcache_enabled'],
    'opcache_enable_cli' => ini_get('opcache.enable_cli'),
    'jit' => ini_get('opcache.jit'),
    'jit_buffer_size' => ini_get('opcache.jit_buffer_size'),
    'iterations' => $_SERVER['DI_BENCH_ITERATIONS'] ?? null,
    'build_iterations' => $_SERVER['DI_BUILD_ITERATIONS'] ?? null,
], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) . "\n");

register_shutdown_function(static function () use ($snapshot): void {
    $checked = [];
    foreach (array_merge(get_declared_classes(), get_declared_interfaces(), get_declared_traits()) as $class) {
        if (!str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\')) {
            continue;
        }
        $file = new ReflectionClass($class)->getFileName();
        if (!is_string($file) || !str_starts_with($file, $snapshot . '/')) {
            fwrite(STDERR, 'ABBA_INVALID_SOURCE ' . json_encode([$class, $file]) . "\n");
            exit(77);
        }
        $checked[$class] = $file;
    }
    fwrite(STDERR, 'ABBA_POSTCHECK ' . json_encode([
        'checked_declarations' => count($checked),
        'all_loaded_di_declarations_in_snapshot' => true,
        'files' => $checked,
    ], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) . "\n");
});

return $snapshotLoader;

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
require __DIR__ . '/di/vendor/autoload.php';

use Componenta\DI\Container;
use Componenta\DI\Tests\Support\ContainerBuilder;
use Psr\Container\ContainerInterface;

function transform(mixed $value, string $suffix): mixed
{
    if (is_callable($value)) {
        return static fn(string $input): mixed => transform($value($input), $suffix);
    }
    return $value . ':' . $suffix;
}

function handler(string $suffix): Closure
{
    return static fn(mixed $value): mixed => transform($value, $suffix);
}

function applyOperation(Container $container, array $operation): void
{
    [$kind, $id, $value] = $operation;
    match ($kind) {
        'value' => $container->set($id, $value),
        'handler' => $container->set($id, handler($value)),
        'alias' => $container->alias($id, $value),
        'delegator' => $container->delegator($id, $value),
        'direct' => $container->delegator($id, handler($value)),
        'external' => $container->addContainer(new class ($id, $value) implements ContainerInterface {
            public function __construct(private string $id, private string $value) {}
            public function has(string $id): bool { return $id === $this->id; }
            public function get(string $id): mixed {
                return str_starts_with($id, 'handler') ? handler($this->value) : $this->value;
            }
        }),
    };
}

function observe(Container $container, string $id): mixed
{
    try {
        $value = $container->get($id);
        return ['value', is_callable($value) ? $value('probe') : $value];
    } catch (Throwable $e) {
        return ['error', $e::class, $e->getMessage()];
    }
}

$ids = ['value0', 'value1', 'value2', 'handler0', 'handler1', 'handler2', 'alias0', 'alias1'];
for ($seed = 1; $seed <= 120; ++$seed) {
    mt_srand($seed);
    $history = [
        ['value', 'value0', 'v0'], ['value', 'value1', 'v1'], ['value', 'value2', 'v2'],
        ['handler', 'handler0', 'h0'], ['handler', 'handler1', 'h1'], ['handler', 'handler2', 'h2'],
        ['alias', 'alias0', 'handler0'], ['alias', 'alias1', 'handler1'],
    ];
    $warm = (new ContainerBuilder())->build();
    foreach ($history as $operation) { applyOperation($warm, $operation); }
    for ($step = 0; $step < 14; ++$step) {
        foreach ($ids as $id) { observe($warm, $id); }
        $n = mt_rand(0, 2);
        $suffix = "s{$seed}.{$step}";
        $operation = match (mt_rand(0, 6)) {
            0 => ['value', 'value' . $n, $suffix],
            1 => ['handler', 'handler' . $n, $suffix],
            2 => ['alias', 'alias' . mt_rand(0, 1), 'handler' . $n],
            3 => ['delegator', 'value' . $n, 'handler' . mt_rand(0, 2)],
            4 => ['direct', $ids[mt_rand(0, count($ids) - 1)], $suffix],
            5 => ['delegator', 'value' . $n, 'alias' . mt_rand(0, 1)],
            6 => ['external', (mt_rand(0, 1) ? 'value' : 'handler') . $n, $suffix],
        };
        $history[] = $operation;
        applyOperation($warm, $operation);
    }
    $fresh = (new ContainerBuilder())->build();
    foreach ($history as $operation) { applyOperation($fresh, $operation); }
    foreach ($ids as $id) {
        $a = observe($warm, $id);
        $b = observe($fresh, $id);
        if ($a !== $b) {
            echo json_encode(['seed' => $seed, 'id' => $id, 'warm' => $a, 'fresh' => $b, 'history' => $history], JSON_PRETTY_PRINT) . PHP_EOL;
            exit(1);
        }
    }
}
echo "120 deterministic histories: warm/fresh values and errors agree.\n";

declare(strict_types=1);
require __DIR__ . '/di/vendor/autoload.php';

use Componenta\DI\Tests\Support\ContainerBuilder;

foreach (['append-first-delegator', 'retarget-first-alias', 'replace-first-deferred-delegator'] as $mutation) {
    $container = (new ContainerBuilder())->build();
    $source = new stdClass();
    $container->set('source', $source);
    $container->set('other-source', new stdClass());
    $container->alias('first', 'source');
    $container->alias('second', 'source');
    $container->set('first.decorator', static fn(object $value): object => (object) ['source' => $value]);
    $container->delegator('first', 'first.decorator');
    $secondCalls = 0;
    $container->delegator('second', static function (object $value) use (&$secondCalls): object {
        return (object) ['source' => $value, 'number' => ++$secondCalls];
    });
    $container->get('first');
    $second = $container->get('second');
    match ($mutation) {
        'append-first-delegator' => $container->delegator('first', static fn(object $value): object => $value),
        'retarget-first-alias' => $container->alias('first', 'other-source'),
        'replace-first-deferred-delegator' => $container->set('first.decorator', static fn(object $value): object => (object) ['source' => $value]),
    };
    echo json_encode([
        'mutation' => $mutation,
        'second_shared_identity_preserved' => $container->get('second') === $second,
        'second_delegator_calls' => $secondCalls,
        'source_identity_preserved' => $container->get('source') === $source,
    ]) . PHP_EOL;
}

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
require __DIR__ . '/di/vendor/autoload.php';

use Componenta\Config\Config;
use Componenta\Config\ContainerValue;
use Componenta\Config\Environment;
use Componenta\Config\LazyValue;
use Componenta\DI\Tests\Support\ContainerBuilder;

foreach ([false, true] as $cache) {
    $state = (object) ['revision' => 1];
    $lazy = new LazyValue(static fn(Config $config): object => (object) [
        'owner' => $config->get('owner'),
        'revision' => $state->revision,
    ], cache: $cache);
    $factory = static fn(ContainerValue $context, array $params): object => (object) [
        'payload' => $context->config->get('payload'),
        'input' => $params['input'],
    ];
    $containers = [];
    $initial = [];
    foreach (['first', 'second'] as $owner) {
        $containers[$owner] = (new ContainerBuilder(new Config([
            'owner' => $owner,
            'payload' => $lazy,
        ], new Environment([]))))->addFactory('product', $factory)->build();
        $initial[$owner] = $containers[$owner]->make('product', ['input' => $owner . '-1']);
    }
    if ($initial['first']->payload === $initial['second']->payload) {
        throw new LogicException('LazyValue leaked a value across configuration contexts.');
    }
    $state->revision = 2;
    foreach (['first', 'second'] as $owner) {
        $fresh = $containers[$owner]->make('product', ['input' => $owner . '-2']);
        if ($fresh->input !== $owner . '-2'
            || $fresh->payload->owner !== $owner
            || $fresh->payload->revision !== ($cache ? 1 : 2)
            || (($fresh->payload === $initial[$owner]->payload) !== $cache)
        ) {
            throw new LogicException('Factory metadata changed current arguments, context or explicit LazyValue cache policy.');
        }
    }
    echo json_encode(['lazy_cache' => $cache, 'context_isolation' => true, 'fresh_factory_arguments' => true, 'native_cache_policy' => true]) . PHP_EOL;
}

evidence_notes: SHA-256 fields hash original captured content before workspace path normalization.
Timing samples are medians of seven rounds within each benchmark process; two process medians per source/runtime do not establish statistical significance.
Runtime ABBA snapshots use identical vendor dependencies, overridden Composer classmap/root functions, and verified actual source paths.
Unavailable-attribute counts are instrumented and use OPcache off; do not compare their latency directly with the OPcache-on runtime ABBA table.
Dependencies were integration-tested through current CI companion workspaces; their entire repositories were not separately audited.
